Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.
"We have faced horrors of war and terrors beyond imagining. We will overcome the uncertainties of this new life."

"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder
Every day, Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.
He represents what little pride the Order has left.
"Every question has a proper answer. Every soul has a proper place."
"Death never stops to rest. Neither can we."

Enlightenment comes most swiftly at life's end.

—Cabal Patriarch
"Honor, guide my step."
Success is one part inspiration, nine parts desperation.
Although the Order frowned upon his preparations for the pits, behind closed doors most saw the fights as a necessary evil.
"I will wield the stone of my homeland as though it were the fists of the Ancestor."

"The truth will outshine all lies."
Dread was as foreign to her as the landscape ahead.
"Your graves will lie beneath my final nest."
"Share your devotion with me."
"Like any pests, goblins must be repelled quickly or they multiply."
The turning of the tide always begins with one soldier's decision to head back into the fray.
"Everyone deserves a chance to live. My job is to make sure they get it."

Cabal spies trying to follow the Order's movements are constantly frustrated by tracks that stop dead.

—Coliseum guard
Entire platoons have mysteriously vanished from battle, leaving enemy weapons to slice through empty air.
They're trained in the art of pressing their luck.

"There is no greater burden than choosing who to save."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte
"I trust what I make for myself. Do you trust more what is made for you by another?"
"We will force the Cabal into their own pits!"
Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.
Newcomers to Otaria find themselves at the bottom of the heap. In the pits, they at least have the chance to climb atop a heap of bodies.
"Our noblest thoughts are our very first and our very last."
"A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."
Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand."
—Akroma, angelic avenger
"Those who live by the sword will die by the sword. I choose to do neither."
"Win together, die alone."
"You may fight if I deem your cause worthy."

"We lay our dead to rest in a beautiful bed, in hopes that the Ancestor will think it a fit cradle for the next life."
—Mystic elder
So great is his certainty that mere facts cannot shake it.
The tall, reedy grass of the Daru Plains rustles loudly in the winds, a perfect cover for any ambush.
His bolas whirl like galaxies, but it's his enemies who see stars.

"The faithful don't succumb to terror, nor are they ruled by passion. They adhere to order, for order is life."
—*Volume I, The Book of Faith*

"We help our Southern Order comrades as much as we can. But the Cabal's insidious influence spreads, dividing our forces and leaving new arrivals to fend for themselves."
—Commander Eesha
Most refugees left their ancestral homes behind when they came to Otaria. A few decided to bring them along.
He brews trouble.
Aphetto con artists started working in pairs to make it less likely they'd be the victims of con artists.
He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.
Some things are better left unknown.
"I'll leave subtlety to the rich."
The most valuable commodity in the pits is a way out.
"Wisdom, clear my eyes."

"I said 'pick his brain,' not 'tear off his head.'"
—Riptide Project researcher

"Like the seas, the Æther is fickle and ever-changing. If we can control one, we can master the other."
—Riptide Project director
"Show weakness to hide your strength."

"Shaping reality is simply a matter of knowing where to apply pressure."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor
"Don't become so enthralled with magic that you forget you can fly without it."

"My past holds only pain and loss. I will conquer it by creating the perfect future."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

"Attempts to revive this ancient species have not been entirely successful, but results indicate potential for future development."
—Riptide Project researcher

"One wizard is a suspect. Two wizards are a conspiracy."
—Elvish refugee
"Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws."
"Some dreams should not come to be."
"Next time, don't bother."

Trust, the fifth myth of reality: Every truth holds the seed of betrayal.
Familiarity, the first myth of reality: What you know the best, you observe the least.
Conviction, the third myth of reality: Only those who seek the truth can be deceived.
Fellowship, the fourth myth of reality: As the tides of war shift, so do loyalties.
"Open your mind to me."

"The world is a puzzle, and the mind is its key."
"Leave the door to the past even slightly ajar and it could be blown off its hinges."

"I've got everything you'd ever need right here. Just give me some time to find it."

"My vengeance will drown my enemies as my storms drown the desert."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor
"It's a fine way to travel, if you don't mind the smell."

The ritual of making draws upon the elves' memories and pasts. And elves have long memories and ancient pasts.
Mulch is the fabric of life in the forest. Plants live in it, they die in it, and then they become part of it, feeding countless generations to come.
Krosa's distorted groves bear strange fruit.
"Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."
"The land belongs to nature as far as our eyes can see. The higher we climb, the more we can see."
The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.
"Though you may leave this haven we have found, may our strength never leave you."

"She is truly Wirewood's child now."
—Elvish refugee

"Instinct is undaunted by terror, unchained by logic. It is the path from which all other paths diverge."
—*Volume V, The Book of Life*

Not all heroes die in armor.

"You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression."
—Gideon Jura
Four claws, two wings, one beak, no fear.
War after war, a healer's enemy is always the same—death itself.
"I do not reject the gods. I reject their authority, their pettiness, and their arrogance."
True faith is letting the blade fall without parry. True cunning is using that moment to strike a deadly blow.

"There is power in abandon, but far more in control."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon
Creatures of darkness instinctively hide from the light.
The ethereal touch brings relief. The physical touch brings peace.
Doors, walls, skulls . . . it matters not. All barriers will be broken.
"To be a knight, Gideon, is to be the shield for the meek against the cruel."

n: Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged

faces.f: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.
"Seal the gate. This is our fight now."

"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

"Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

"A master of hieromancy can see the advantage in any scenario."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon
"My scars are my sigils. I will wear them with pride long after you're gone."
It is hunted, but not for the kill. The magic within draws others to its presence.

They became a single entity, a phalanx in the Temple of Triumph standing against a host of enemies.
It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.
"When you are felled by my mace, you shall know it was divine fate."

—*The Theriad*

"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

Stray into the Morkrut and it may rise to claim you.

n: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy // Jace, Telepath Unbound

Energy surges in Izzet labs are opportunities for experimentation.

—Ludevic, necro-alchemist
